messages:
Anya: Async standup — quick updates on API gateway / routing / auth / rate-limits. I'll go first.
- Yesterday: landed gw-routing retry fix (PR #3421), ran perf tests against dev cluster.
- Blocker: rate-limit config drift between canary and prod still happening, causing inconsistent throttles.
- Today: sync with infra to consolidate configs and add a cache-flush plan.

Rajesh: Reviewed #3421, left a couple minor nits but looks good. Not blocking.
Blocker for me: policy cache invalidation — after rollout some nodes still served old rules. Will add explicit cache-flush endpoint.

Linh: Picked up an auth token rotation bug this morning. Ops logs show intermittent 401s tied to token issuer rotation. Repro steps in a sec. Working on a small validation fix.

Sam: I can pair with Rajesh on the cache flush and own the canary->prod config merge. Can we delay the canary promotion by 1h while we add the flush? :calendar:

ops-bot: deploy: canary deploy completed for gateway v1.12.3 -> us-west.
- Recent errors: 3 x 401 in the last 10m (traces: trace/ab12, trace/cd34, trace/ef56)

Marco: Heads-up — I added a temporary rate-limit rule to block a noisy client (rule id rl-98). Active in staging only. Recommend adding a short-term metric (rps by client) to the gateway dashboard.

Anya: @Sam delaying by 1h is fine. @Linh paste the repro steps + any minimal curl snippet here so I can triage quickly. If rollback needed, tag me and I’ll trigger it.

Linh: Repro steps:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <old-token>' https://api.redwood.dev/some-route
# response: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
# logs: auth-service rejected token issuer "old-issuer"
```
Patch idea: validate token issuer list against the latest rotation map during request validation (small diff). Will open PR in ~30m.

Rajesh: Draft for cache flush endpoint (proposal):
```
POST /admin/cache/flush?scope=policy
Body: { "keys": ["routing:v1", "rate:global"] }
```
We should make this an authenticated ops-only endpoint and emit events to audit log. Thoughts?

Sam: LGTM for the API shape. Add a permission check for the ops role and a 30s rate-limit on flush calls.

Anya: Sounds good. Next: postmortem owners if we see a spike in 401s — @Marco lead, @Linh second.
Thanks all. :thumbsup:
